title: Injectivity of the point assignment
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and put $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. Assign to each $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ the length-$d$ binary vector at position $j$ in an enumeration of all such vectors. This assignment is injective: distinct indices receive distinct vectors.
